statements.proposition: The author ran `make test-community` and the tests pass.
statements.label: CANNOT_TELL
statements.note: Ticked checkbox is a claim. The PR only adds two files under .github/workflows (README.md and pr-approval-check.yml), so it cannot alter Go test outcomes, but the claim is that the tests pass. I built Go 1.24.7 and ran `make test-community` at head d1f6a0f: the sandbox scratch space ran out ('no space left on device') while compiling ~1000 detector packages, so every package reported [build failed] for an environment reason; no result obtained. CI: the 'test-community' job was skipped (only runs for fork PRs), and the separate 'test' job (a different command, with cloud auth) has one failure and one success among two runs of the head commit; logs expired (HTTP 410), so cause unknown.
evidence: gh api pulls/4478/files: added .github/workflows/README.md, added .github/workflows/pr-approval-check.yml; nothing else
make test-community in sandbox: rc=2, all packages '[build failed]' with 'no space left on device' errors
